newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to announce key staff choices - report.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to announce key staff choices - report.

text.p: President Clinton Wednesday plans to announce key members of his second-term White House team, including the elevation of longtime aide Rahm Emmanuel to the post vacated by senior adviser George Stephanopoulos, the Washington Post reported.

Quoting unidentified administration officials, the newspaper said in Wednesday editions Clinton also would appoint State Department policy director James Steinberg as deputy national security adviser.

Emmanuel was a Clinton fundraiser in 1992 and issues strategist in 1996, while Steinberg acted as a foreign policy consultant to Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign and as a campaign staff member for 1988 Democratic nominee Michael Dukakis.
The Post said Clinton would announce the long-expected appointments of John Podesta and Sylvia Mathews as deputy chiefs of staff under Erskine Bowles.

Clinton did not expect to make more Cabinet appointments until Friday, the newspaper said, adding that Rodney Slater, head of the Federal Highway Administration was the prohibitive favourite for transportation secretary.

Elizabeth Moler, chairman of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, was equally likely to be named energy secretary, while Representative Esteban Torres, a California Democrat was the leading candidate for labour secretary, according to the report.
